description: This file defines the code-behind logic for the UserProfile page in an online examination system. It handles displaying user information retrieved from a SQL database upon page load, manages session validation, and provides navigation to other pages such as Dashboard, Leaderboard, and Login.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for the UserProfile ASP.NET page, managing user session validation, data retrieval, and page navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves user data from database if session exists, or redirects to login if not.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle profile button click but currently commented out.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.
